Jordan, so the stairwell turn upstairs can't safely accommodate the piano — that means the ground-floor living room is our only real placement option. Good to know.

Leah, Nora Chen inspected it and quoted $780 for tuning and regulation, recommended that work be done before anyone uses it, but did NOT recommend refinishing. So we prep with tuning and regulation only, skip refinishing.

Tessa, you've told Rosa Alvarez in principle that the piano could host free youth lessons Saturdays 10 to 12, August 1st through September 5th of 2026. That's a significant commitment for the living room space, and I appreciate you bringing it to the group now.

So here's what I'm leaning toward: place the piano in the ground-floor living room, have Nora Chen do the tuning and regulation for $780 before any use, and honor the Saturday lesson commitment Rosa asked about — with the understanding that the living room will be occupied those Saturday mornings. No refinishing.

Does anyone have anything to add before I finalize this?
